mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation models and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that may prompt central bank intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher interest rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a further increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals continued hawkish policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates reduce equity attractiveness.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
